name: Saraev-like Talking Head
tagline: Raw talking-head footage goes in; a tight, voice-led cut with a swivel teaser and editorial graphics comes out.
description: A deterministic workflow grounded in observed public Nick Saraev videos: Silero voice-activity cuts around half-second silences, Whisper word times and the spoken "cut cut" marker, high-pass/EQ/compression to about -16 LUFS, a low-saturation grade, an optional continuous-voice swivel teaser, three graphics modes, no word-by-word captions, and hardware export with a software fallback. Unexposed private settings remain configurable.
bring: Optional: real screenshots, articles, charts or screen recordings for graphics
Optional: an earlier render or locally held reference for side-by-side comparison
get: A clean 16:9 talking-head video, an auditable edit plan, optional evidence-backed graphics, and short comparison renders

needs.name: Edit template and deterministic helper scripts
Speech to text with word timestamps

stylesNote: grade, graphic panels, labels and teaser treatment
steps: Inspect and transcribe the raw recording
Detect speech and build an auditable cut around half-second gaps
Remove marked bad takes when Whisper finds the spoken "cut cut"
Enhance audio, grade picture, and add the optional teaser and evidence-backed graphics
Render short samples, compare them, then export with a supported encoder
Review each version in FrameJam until it is approved
